injuries.detail: Reaves (heel) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Suns, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.
The Suns claimed Timme off waivers Monday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.
Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
